def SIDEExplicitFormula.Doubling.DoublingCorollary : Prop :=
∀ (C : SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.WeilConfig),
  (∀ ρ ∈ C.carrier, (SIDEExplicitFormula.Product.sum C C).mult ρ = 2 * C.mult ρ) ∧
    (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (SIDEExplicitFormula.Product.sum C C) ↔
      SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg C)
def SIDEExplicitFormula.Doubling.doubledToy : SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.WeilConfig :=
